about: One faulty fixture (or more) per COVER, TIME and STATE check of blueprint 7.2, made by tests/wp4c_acceptance.py from a temporary copy of the WP12a gold (examples/01 The Catch - scene 10.md and examples/02 The Catch - scene 10 - context.md), which gives none of these lines. Each fault edits lines inside named records ('find' must occur in the record, and its first occurrence becomes 'replace'), or removes a record, or adds one after a named record; 'story_edits' change the scene 10 excerpt in the same way (every line keeps its number). 'file' is 'scene' or 'context'. The test runs the COVER, TIME and STATE checks with the excerpt as the story (or no story when 'story' is 'none') at 'step' (null is check --all) and expects a line of 7.2's form: level, check ID, record, field, what is wrong, then 'Fix:'. When 'exact' is given, the line (without its file and line placing) must be exactly that. 'build' 2 marks the faults of build-2 checks; 'needs_story' marks the faults that cannot be seen without the story (without the excerpt the others run with no story).
